data.review_body: I've bought some good quality low cost items including pink wigs, chain mail bags and crushed stone nail art from Aliexpress. CHOICE is especially useful, spend £8 for free shipping. On two occasions though they wanted me to pay for return shipping so it's not always free (as stated). I ended up keeping the unwanted items as it wasn't cost effective to send them back. Fully tracked delivery in 8-10 days or you get a £1 late delivery coupon for your next order which isn't bad.
